subject.title: feat: add editable voice dictation to the Control UI

question: Should Control UI editable dictation be accepted as a core Gateway-backed audio transcription feature once this branch is ported and proven?
rationale: The implementation direction is more aligned than direct browser Web Speech, but accepting a browser-to-Gateway microphone-audio RPC is a product and security-boundary choice that code review cannot authorize by itself.

options.title: Continue after proof and port
options.body: Require the branch or replacement to port onto current main, fix the docs/accessibility defects, and provide successful redacted real behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Pause behind the feature issue
options.body: Keep the paired issue and this PR open while maintainers decide the permanent Control UI dictation boundary and owner surface.

options.title: Close or supersede this branch
options.body: If maintainers prefer a fresh implementation or do not want core dictation now, close this PR and route future work through the paired issue or a new narrow PR.

recommendation.title: Continue after proof and port
recommendation.body: Require the branch or replacement to port onto current main, fix the docs/accessibility defects, and provide successful redacted real behavior proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest feature-history signal for the prior Gateway-backed dictation path and is the clearest available owner for the boundary decision.
